video_prompt: Locked-off tripod shot of ONE woman alone in a podcast studio. She is the only living thing in the frame from the first frame to the last. Absolutely no one else may appear: no man, no interviewer, no guest, no second person, no shoulder, no back of a head, no arm, no hand, nothing entering from the left, right, top or bottom edge. The camera never moves, the background and furniture never change. The woman in the sage-green top explains something calmly to someone off-camera, small natural head movements, her own hands resting still in her lap.
